## Problem Description

A clear and concise description of the limitation or gap this request
addresses. For example: "The pipeline currently does not support
descriptor sets other than Morgan fingerprints."

## Suggested Solution

A clear and concise description of the proposed change or addition.

## Alternatives Considered

A description of any alternative solutions or features considered, and why
they were not preferred.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, references, or literature relevant to this request
(e.g., citations supporting a proposed descriptor set or modeling method).
